facts.text: In India, projects with capacity up to 25 MW fall within this category.
India has an identified potential of 21,134 MW across 7,133 sites, of which about a quarter is harnessed.
Small Hydropower (SHP), comprising projects with installed capacity up to 25 MW , offers significant opportunities for harnessing India's untapped water resources.
Small Hydropower Projects (SHP) are defined as those with an installed capacity of up to 25 MW and are administered by the Ministry of New and Renewable Energy (MNRE).
